feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 18 November 2026 11:00pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 18 November 2026 at 11:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong Winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the west of Ireland, bringing complex frontal zones across the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

Mainly east or northeast 3 to 5, but occasionally 6 in the far north at first and variable 3 or 4 in southern waters, increasing east 4 to 6 in all waters through the morning, but occasionally 7 in the north at first. Decreasing 4 or 5 in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly moderate tomorrow afternoon but remaining slight towards the English coast.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or showers, clearing to become mainly fair later tomorrow.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or northeast 4 or 5, decreasing northeast 3 or 4 Friday morning, then backing northerly 2 or 3 in the afternoon, becoming variable later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight Friday morning.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or showers at first, becoming fair.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain or showers at first.
